name: TourCostingQuoteBuilder
tagline: Price group tours per person – supplier costs, FX, margins, price breaks, versions and approvals in one plug-and-play app.
description: A complete tour costing and quoting app for Power Apps and Power Pages: cost lines per person, room, vehicle or group in any supplier currency, FX buffer, margin on sell with line overrides, free places and single supplements, price-break tables by group size, quote versions with a line diff, and an approval workflow with a margin floor.
features: Per person / per room (twin) / per vehicle / per group cost bases
Supplier currency conversion with FX buffer
Target margin and per-line margin (margin on sell)
Price breaks chart and table by group size
Approval rules: margin floor, value limit, below-cost lines
Status flow Draft → Submitted → Approved/Rejected → Sent → Accepted/Declined/Expired
Inline editing, bulk actions, undo, CSV export
Demo mode, map-your-columns, phone bottom bar
controlType: standard (2 controls: TourCostingQuoteBuilder data-set + TourCostingQuoteBuilderPortal field control)
